extracted.intended_audience: general readers of Victorian-era colonial/military anecdotes and travelogues
extracted.subtask_description: Narrative accounts and anecdotes about military cantonment life in colonial India (personal reminiscence/fictionalised reportage), focusing on marches, social life, hunting/shikar, and camp incidents. Useful for authors drafting first‑person or third‑person vignette-style military/colonial stories.
